notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it.
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Quest for Pure Flame.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2
